title: Cedar Creek Marina

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Looking for the top spot for Nashville boat rentals? Cedar Creek Marina is your gateway to adventure on Old Hickory Lake, just a short drive from downtown Nashville. Whether you’re planning a relaxing day on the water or a lively group outing, our marina is the perfect starting point for discovering this scenic Tennessee destination. As one of the most trusted providers of Old Hickory pontoon rentals, we offer well-maintained boats ideal for family outings, fishing trips, and unforgettable lake days with friends.
